title: Killing Floor
author: Lee Child
summary: A former military policeman drifting across America is arrested for murder in a quiet Georgia town just after stepping off a bus. He is a stranger with no connection to the victim, which makes him a very good suspect.
readIf: you want a fast, muscular thriller with a calm, capable hero.
skipIf: you want subtle characters or realistic violence, as the hero is almost superhumanly tough.

pairings.reason: Another capable loner caught in a conspiracy bigger than he thought, with more spy craft.
A cooler, more procedural thriller that is gripping because of its precision.
